name: csharp-lsp
instructions:
csharp_definition, csharp_references and csharp_diagnostics answer questions about C# and Razor source (.cs, .csx, .razor, .cshtml) under the working directory. Any other file is refused.

Positions are 1-based — line 1 is the first line, character 1 the first column — and must land inside the symbol's name.

csharp_diagnostics reports what has already been analysed. Immediately after a file is first touched it may return nothing; calling csharp_definition or csharp_references on that file first gives the analysis time to happen.

Razor files may return no results if the environment lacks Razor analysis. An empty result means nothing was found, not that the call failed.

tools.name: csharp_definition
tools.description: Finds where the symbol at a C# or Razor file position is DECLARED. Crosses project boundaries: a reference in a test project resolves to a declaration in the project under test, if the server has indexed both.

file.description: Path to a C# or Razor file (.cs, .csx, .razor, .cshtml), relative to the working directory or absolute.

character.description: 1-based column, landing inside the symbol's name.

tools.name: csharp_references
tools.description: Finds every place the symbol at a C# or Razor file position is USED, across every project the server has indexed.

file.description: Path to a C# or Razor file (.cs, .csx, .razor, .cshtml), relative to the working directory or absolute.

character.description: 1-based column, landing inside the symbol's name.

tools.name: csharp_diagnostics
tools.description: Reports the current errors and warnings for a C# or Razor file — whatever has already been computed, not a fresh compile on demand.

file.description: Path to a C# or Razor file (.cs, .csx, .razor, .cshtml), relative to the working directory or absolute.
